content.text: [Feishu 群组「RCA 工作进展」angela_reyes Wed Apr 08 09:00 EST 2026] IMPORTANT UPDATE — REVISED FIELD SAFETY NOTICE: The Ivenix LVP Field Safety Notice has been revised. The affected software version description has been corrected: the correct statement is 'version 5.10.1 AND EARLIER' (not just '5.10.0'). Recall Number Z-0885-2026 is confirmed. Product code: LVP-SW-0005. All RCA outputs referencing Ivenix affected software version must use '5.10.1 and earlier' going forward. Prior references to '5.10.0 only' are incorrect. Revised FSN attached (cases/case_B_ivenix/field_safety_notice_revised_v2.md).

ACKNOWLEDGED — Field Safety Notice revision noted. Effective immediately:
- Ivenix affected software version: '5.10.1 and earlier' (supersedes any prior '5.10.0 only' references)
- Recall Number: Z-0885-2026 confirmed
- Product Code: LVP-SW-0005 confirmed
All subsequent outputs will reflect this correction. Q07 output (ivenix_tech_summary_v1.md) reflects pre-update state and is now superseded.
